description: This C# source file contains extension methods for configuring TLS (Transport Layer Security) on connection builders within the Orleans framework. It provides methods to set up server and client TLS middleware, as well as an internal method for throwing exceptions related to missing private keys in certificates.

classes.name: TlsConnectionBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IConnectionBuilder to support TLS configurations.

methods.name: UseServerTls
methods.description: Adds server TLS middleware to the connection pipeline with specified options.

methods.name: UseClientTls
methods.description: Adds client TLS middleware to the connection pipeline with specified options.

methods.name: ThrowNoPrivateKey
methods.description: Internal method that throws an exception if a certificate does not contain a private key.
